text: Yellow Hat Ltd.'s top-10 shareholders as of 31 March 2026 are led by Kouei Kikaku Co. ((株)幸栄企画, 14.67%), a Japan-Up trust at Intertrust Trustees Cayman (standing proxy Mizuho Bank, 9.68%), The Master Trust Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 9.23%), the Yellow Hat Kyowa-kai association (6.43%) and a second Japan-Up trust (standing proxy Tachibana Securities, 4.67%).
short: Yellow Hat's top-10 holders as of 31 March 2026: Kouei Kikaku 14.67%, Japan-Up trust 9.68%, Master Trust 9.23%.

source.name: イエローハット: 株式の状況（大株主（上位10名）, 2026年3月31日現在）
